'''Guild Wars Nightfall''' is the third [[campaign]] of [[Guild Wars]], released on October 27, 2006. It is set in the North-African-themed continent of [[Elona]].

[[Image:Guild Wars Nightfall logo.png|right|400px]]

==System requirements==
The minimum system requirements to play Guild Wars Nightfall are:

*Windows XP/2000 operating system
*Intel Pentium III 1 GHz processor
*512 MB RAM
*CD-ROM drive
*3 GB hard disk space
*64 MB ATi Radeon 8500 or nVidia GeForce 3 class video card
*16-bit sound card
*Internet connection
*Keyboard
*Mouse
*DirectX 8

The recommended system requirements to play Guild Wars Nightfall are:
*Windows XP/2000 operating system
*Intel Pentium 4 2.0GHz processor
*1GB RAM
*CD-ROM drive
*4GB hard disk space
*ATi Radeon or nVidia GeForce FX 5700 class video card
*16-bit sound card
*Internet connection
*Keyboard
*Mouse

*DirectX 9

===''Guild Wars Nightfall PvP Edition''===
The PvP editions are only available for ordering online in the official ''Guild Wars'' store. The PvP editions give instant access and full skill lists for the PvP mode and the professions covered by the respective campaigns. They do not provide access to the PvE campaigns. PvP editions are cumulative; multiple editions purchased will allow PvP players to access the sum of all unlocked skills. PvP and regular editions can be mixed, but then only allowing players to travel into the PvE worlds that the full editions provide.

The ''Guild Wars Nightfall PvP Edition'' allows players to create the [[Paragon]] and [[Dervish]] characters, in addition to the professions introduced in ''Guild Wars Prophecies''.

Additionally, the following skills are unlocked, for a total of 701 skills:
*350 [[:Category:Nightfall skills|''Nightfall'' skills]]
*110 Elite ''Nightfall'' skills
*241 [[:Category:Core skills|Core skills]]

==Professions==
Two additional [[profession]]s were introduced in ''Nightfall''. 

{{P}} '''[[Paragon]]'''
:A ranged [[spear]] wielding class, they rally allies with a variety of chants and shouts while attacking enemies at range.

{{D}} '''[[Dervish]]'''
:A melee class specializing in the use of [[scythe]]s to deal damage to all enemies around them. Their faith grants them the use of powerful [[enchantment]]s.

==Elona==
The continent that ''Guild Wars Nightfall'' is based on, offers many opportunities for the player.
[[Image:Elona unexplored map.jpg|thumb|225px|Continent of Elona]]
===5 distinct regions===
:'''[[Istan]]'''
::An island province littered with the ruins of an earlier Elonian empire.

:'''[[Kourna]]'''
::Known for its fiercely loyal soldiers, dedicated army, expansive estates, and thriving agriculture.

:'''[[Vabbi]]'''
::This northern province is home to wealthy merchant princes, a land where successful Elonians believe their safety, security, and affluence allow them to sponsor many of their nation’s greatest achievements.

:'''[[The Desolation]]'''
::The most hostile region in all of [[Elona]]; any mortal who steps into its sands will be instantly slain. It is a land of poisonous sulfur deserts home to many undead creatures and the great [[Junundu]] wurms. 

:'''[[Realm of Torment]]'''
::The prison of [[Abaddon]], the fallen God of Secrets. He was exiled to this place by the five Gods of Tyria. From there he seeks to gain back control and spread evil into the world of the mortals, eventually trying to break from his prison.

==Player versus Player==

==Access==
Access to Guild Wars Nightfall requires a valid [[access key]] to be added to your [[account]]. Once added, select Nightfall when creating a new character to create a new Nightfall character. Existing characters from other campaigns can access Elona via a special [[quest]]. See the [[Elona]] article for more details.
